items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: Oliver So Sy Alter had did the arrangements but he hadn't sent Louie the music.

ctx.x: But getting back to the sound, we recorded Louie over there. I engineered with them when Louie did "Sit Down You Rock The Boat." year that That (inaudible) Louie had that small band. And Louie came in to do a date, and he wanted me to come over to the studio and meet him.
When I got there, he said -- Oliver So Sy Alter had did the arrangements but he hadn't sent Louie the music. Louie was really mad about it.

Because Louie Armstrong was a musician that came out of Jenkins Home. Everybody thought Louie was just a high note from (inaudible), but Louie was a great musician. Louie - (inaudible) all those fellows that came out of that home down there -- Louisiana.
